correctness.rationale: For each proper frequency U, the marked comparison runs use disjoint vertex blocks, so relative rankings are independent and give exact Eulerian factors. The full circular frequency follows from cyclic rotation to a maximum-at-end word. Signed Eulerian evaluations make every surviving multiplier sign (-1)^(|U|/2). The matching-covered-set map is bijective except for the two perfect matchings when n is even; the cycle matching polynomial yields rank L_n-1_even and q_n=2cos(n*pi/3) sign imbalance, hence the full inertia. All boundaries \(n\ge3\) are handled; 2081 independently enumerated exact assertions checked n=3..9 and Eulerian values through 40.

value.rationale: A natural complete all-dimensional classification of a nontrivial convolution operator: the exact recoverable subspace, signs of all nonzero eigenvalues, exact positive/negative/zero inertia, six-periodic imbalance, and exponential loss of Fourier modes. The cycle closure changes the rank relative to the classical matching count through a precise two-perfect-matching collision. This invariant governs which circular-descent signals can be recovered, without choosing arbitrary slice parameters.
